title: Sou'wester
wikitext: {{Infobox mousehat |name = Sou'wester |image = Sou'wester.png |achievement = Fisherman |ad = Catch 10 different [[Fish|fish]]. |price = {{Price|1000}} }} The '''Sou'wester''' is a [[Hats|hat]] that can be purchased from the [[Abandoned House]] for {{Price|1000}} after earning the "Fisherman" [[Achievements|Achievement]] (catch 10 different [[Fish|fish]]). It can also be obtained from [[Desert Festival#Emily's Outfit Services|Emily's outfit services]] at the [[Desert Festival]]. There is a ≈2% chance to receive the gender-neutral outfit with the Sou'wester. ==Notes== * The Sou'wester outfit also includes the [[File:Shirt260.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Shirts|Rain Coat]] and [[File:Relaxed Fit Pants.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Pants|Relaxed Fit Pants]] (dyed RGB value 255,169,2). ==References== Male players have 47 possible outfits (1/47 ≈ 2.13%), while female players have 48 possible ones (1/48 ≈ 2.08%). See Content\Data\MakeoverOutfits.xnb.
